reapack.name: Create_Regions_From_Parent_Name.lua
reapack.desc: Create regions from parent track name

metadata.description:
# Create regions from parent track name
Makes one region per selected item, named after the folder track the item lives in. A folder called Weapons gives you regions called Weapons, which is what you want when a folder holds many takes of the same sound.
An item that is not inside a folder falls back to its own take name, with the file extension trimmed, so loose items still get something sensible.
Each region gets a random colour so neighbours stay easy to tell apart in the ruler.

# Separate and join items
Lays the selected items end to end, either with an even gap between them or butted together with none. Useful for spacing out a batch of takes before rendering them, or closing the gaps again afterwards.
The first item never moves: everything else lines up after it, so the result stays anchored where you put it.
Items are laid out in timeline order rather than selection order, so a selection spanning several tracks does not come out shuffled.
Requires ReaImGui, installable from ReaPack.
